description:
Change your profile name

Changes the name of your account, the `name` that `get_my_account` returns. It applies at once and can be changed back the same way. Only the name changes here: the email address can only be changed by support (ask with `create_ticket`), the invoice address is set with `set_billing_address`. Only the account owner can call this; a team member gets 403.

body.description: The request fields as one JSON object.
